text_en: No sooner had Boaz gone up to the gate and sat down there than the next-of-kin, of whom Boaz had spoken, came passing by. So Boaz said, “Come over, friend; sit down here. ” And he went over and sat down.
text_cn: 波阿次走上城门口，坐在那里。可巧，波阿次所说的那位至亲，正从那里经过，他就对他说：“某兄，请过来，坐一坐！”他就过去坐下了。

text_en: Then Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here”; so they sat down.
text_cn: 波阿次又由城内的长老中，邀请了十位，对他们说：“请你们在这里坐一坐！”他们就都坐下。

text_en: He then said to the next-of-kin, “Naomi, who has come back from the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land that belonged to our kinsman Elimelech.
text_cn: 波阿次便对那位至亲说：“从摩阿布乡间回来的纳敖米要卖我们兄弟厄里默肋客的一块田。

text_en: So I thought I would tell you of it, and say: Buy it in the presence of those sitting here, and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not, tell me, so that I may know; for there is no one prior to you to redeem it, and I come after you. ” So he said, “I will redeem it. ”
text_cn: 我认为我应在你面前说明这事，并请你当着在坐的诸位及民众的长老前，购买这块地。若你愿意尽你至亲的义务，就尽；若你不愿意尽，请告诉我知道；因为除你应尽这义务之外，没有别人了；你以后就是我。”那人答说：“我尽。”

text_en: Then Boaz said, “The day you acquire the field from the hand of Naomi, you are also acquiring Ruth the Moabite, the widow of the dead man, to maintain the dead man’s name on his inheritance. ”
text_cn: 波阿次接着说：“你从纳敖米手中购得田地的那一天，也应娶亡者之妻，即摩阿布女子卢德，好给死者在嗣业上留名。”

text_en: At this, the next-of-kin said, “I cannot redeem it for myself without damaging my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption yourself, for I cannot redeem it. ”
text_cn: 那位至亲答说：“那么我就不能尽这义务了，免得我的产业受害，你尽我应尽的义务吧！我不能尽了。”

text_en: Now this was the custom in former times in Israel concerning redeeming and exchanging: to confirm a transaction, the one took off a sandal and gave it to the other; this was the manner of attesting in Israel.
text_cn: 从前在以色列中间，无论对于买卖或交易，为确定一事，有这样的一个风俗：就是一方应脱下自己的鞋，交与另一方：这在以色列就算为证据。

text_en: So when the next-of-kin said to Boaz, “Acquire it for yourself, ” he took off his sandal.
text_cn: 那位至亲对波阿次说：“你购买吧！”遂就脱下了自己的鞋。

text_en: Then Boaz said to the elders and all the people, “Today you are witnesses that I have acquired from the hand of Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech and all that belonged to Chilion and Mahlon.
text_cn: 于是波阿次对长老及所有在坐的民众说：“今天你们作证，我从纳敖米手中购得了属于厄里默肋客及基肋雍与玛赫隆的一切产业；

text_en: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon, to be my wife, to maintain the dead man’s name on his inheritance, in order that the name of the dead may not be cut off from his kindred and from the gate of his native place; today you are witnesses. ”
text_cn: 同时我也取得了玛赫隆的妻，摩阿布的女子卢德为我的妻室，好给死者在嗣业上留名，不叫死者的名字，在自己的兄弟和故乡的门户中失传；今日你们为此作证！”

text_en: Then all the people who were at the gate, along with the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your house like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you produce children in Ephrathah and bestow a name in Bethlehem;
text_cn: 在城门旁的民众和长老都回答说：“我们作证。愿上主使这走进你家中的妇女，像似那两位曾建立了以色列家的辣黑耳和肋阿！愿你在厄弗辣大昌盛，愿你在白冷得享盛名！

text_en: and, through the children that the Lord will give you by this young woman, may your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah. ”
text_cn: 愿你的家藉上主使这少妇给你所生的后裔（yì），相似塔玛尔给犹大所生的培勒兹的家。”

text_en: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When they came together, the Lord made her conceive, and she bore a son.
text_cn: 波阿次遂娶了卢德，她就成了他的妻子。他走近了她，上主赐她怀孕，生了一个儿子。

text_en: Then the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the Lord , who has not left you this day without next-of-kin; and may his name be renowned in Israel!
text_cn: 妇女们就对纳敖米说：“愿上主受颂扬！因为他没有使你今日缺乏承继者。愿他在以色列中得享盛名！

text_en: He shall be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age; for your daughter-in-law who loves you, who is more to you than seven sons, has borne him. ”
text_cn: 他是你心灵的安慰，是你老年的依靠，因为他是爱你的儿媳所生的；像这样的儿媳，对你实胜过七个儿子。”

text_en: Then Naomi took the child and laid him in her bosom, and became his nurse.
text_cn: 纳敖米接过婴儿来，抱在怀中，做了他的保母。

text_en: The women of the neighborhood gave him a name, saying, “A son has been born to Naomi. ” They named him Obed; he became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
text_cn: 邻近的妇女喊着说：“纳敖米得了个儿子！”她们就给他起名叫敖贝得；他就是达味的父亲叶瑟的父亲。

text_en: Now these are the descendants of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,
text_cn: 以下是培勒兹的族谱：培勒兹生赫兹龙，

text_en: Hezron of Ram, Ram of Amminadab,
text_cn: 赫兹龙生兰，兰生阿米纳达布，

text_en: Amminadab of Nahshon, Nahshon of Salmon,
text_cn: 阿米纳达布生纳赫雄，纳赫雄生撒耳孟，

text_en: Salmon of Boaz, Boaz of Obed,
text_cn: 撒耳孟生波阿次，波阿次生敖贝得，

text_en: Obed of Jesse, and Jesse of David.
text_cn: 敖贝得生叶瑟，叶瑟生达味。
